name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=vga_palette, descriptor=range). No address residue. Accurately reflects behavior: writes DAC palette entries over the index range [start_idx..end_idx]. The darken/subtract nuance is conveyed by the sister-function naming pair (this base name vs fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add).
purpose: VGA DAC palette write primitive: writes palette entries [start_idx..end_idx] to the DAC, subtracting brightness_subtract from each R/G/B channel (clamped at 0) to darken toward black.
logic_summary: For idx from start_idx to end_idx inclusive: outp(0x3C8, idx) to select the DAC index register, then for each of the 3 channels (R,G,B) compute val = base_palette[idx*3 + k] - brightness_subtract, clamp negatives to 0, and outp(0x3C9, val) to the DAC data register. Base palette bytes come from data_fd2_vga_palette_data_ptr (768-byte standard VGA palette loaded from FDOTHER.DAT[0]). Compiler-generated __CHK(0x18) stack probe prologue precedes the loop in the binary.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_set_vga_palette_range(uint32 start_idx, uint32 end_idx, uint32 brightness_subtract)

params.name: start_idx
params.semantics: First VGA DAC palette index in the range to write (inclusive). Callers pass 0 for full-range fades.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches loop init (idx = start_idx) and the outp(0x3C8, idx) index selection. No address residue.

params.name: end_idx
params.semantics: Last VGA DAC palette index in the range (inclusive; loop condition is idx <= end_idx). Callers pass 0xFF for full-range fades.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches the inclusive loop bound. No address residue.

params.name: brightness_subtract
params.semantics: Amount subtracted from each R/G/B channel before writing, clamped at 0 (black). Range 0..0x3F: 0 = base palette unchanged, 0x3F+ = full black. Drives fade-to-black / fade-in steps.
params.reason: Descriptive of exact role (subtract-then-clamp darken amount). No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is writing the VGA DAC palette registers (ports 0x3C8/0x3C9).
